about: What to type, per vertical. Each entry is one prompt and the use case it runs. Banking text is the catalog's own chip text (data/usecases.json trigger.text, verbatim; a test pins it), except UC13 (a forged acting agent), a staged attack with no catalog chip, whose prompt is lab-written for the walkthrough's step 6. Healthcare, retail and software (the Appfire Work Suite, Jira and Confluence wording) are lab-written for the same use cases (lab-invented, a test proves each one runs its use case); software also carries five extra lab-written prompts after the core fourteen: an allowed and a refused third-party tool call, another person's private project, a forged approval and a lower human-approval rung. Prompts whose use case routes Hand off (data/handoff.json) show under "Opens its own app": the chat answers them with the hand-off card, and Preview here runs them in the mock engine. Stub verticals have no demo pack yet, so no prompts.
